title: 渣打：金价有望迈向5000美元，结构性买盘仍强劲
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: 4200 is your price target for gold, we are those seeing a Fed that doesn't seem as willing to cut as it once was. What gives you the confidence that there are still more gains to go for the
segments.zh: 4200美元是你的黄金目标价，我们看到美联储似乎不像以前那样愿意降息。是什么让你有信心黄金还有更多上涨空间？

segments.en: precious metal? There's a few factors here when we're looking at the gold market, those structural drivers are still very much intact and here we're looking at the central bank demand, we're also
segments.zh: 有几个因素，当我们看黄金市场时，结构性驱动因素仍然完好，这里我们看到央行需求，还有更广泛的市场参与者购买黄金的意愿。

segments.en: looking at that wider investor appetite to want to buy gold and those drivers are still very much there suggesting that investors are really looking for an opportunity to rebuild their positioning, rebuild
segments.zh: 这些驱动因素仍然存在，表明市场参与者真的在寻找机会重建仓位，重建价格涨幅，但黄金也已经消化了很多不利因素。

segments.en: those price gains but also gold is factored in a lot of the headwinds already. As you mentioned at the start of the year the market was looking at rate cuts and now it's pricing in rate hikes
segments.zh: 正如你在年初提到的，市场预期降息，现在却在定价加息，但我们也看到黄金的关注点从结构性驱动因素转向利率预期。

segments.en: but we've also seen gold switching its focus away from some of those structural drivers and also towards rate cuts expectations or rate hike expectations but we think a lot of those headwinds are
segments.zh: 但我们认为很多不利因素已经被定价了。

segments.en: already priced in. Well how much do you have to factor in what's going on outside of gold in the sense that bond yields are still much higher, more attractive at this point and they don't seem
segments.zh: 那么你多大程度上要考虑黄金之外的因素，比如债券收益率仍然高得多，更具吸引力，而且似乎不会下降。

segments.en: to be going down. The Fed if anything is going to be raising interest rates so isn't the risk against a rebound in gold? We have seen that correlation between gold and real yield, gold and the dollar
segments.zh: 美联储甚至可能加息，那么黄金反弹的风险不是很大吗？我们已经看到黄金与实际收益率、美元之间的相关性开始再次增强，达到2022年以来的水平。

segments.en: starting to strengthen again to levels that we last saw back in 2022. So certainly in the near term we think some of these macro drivers have become much more important but if also we go back to the
segments.zh: 所以短期内我们认为一些宏观驱动因素变得更加重要，但如果我们回到冲突开始，黄金是满足流动性需求的主要候选者。

segments.en: start of this conflict gold was a prime candidate to meet liquidity needs positioning was top-e prices were scaling record highs so it was coming under a lot of pressure amid liquidity needs
segments.zh: 仓位很高，价格创下历史新高，所以它因流动性需求而承受很大压力。
